prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW original photographic campaign asset for Frontaliere Ticino, a service that finds Swiss job offers suitable for a person's trade and prepares the applications for them. The provided images are REFERENCE IMAGES for the intended audience and practical working-world visual language, not edit targets; do not copy their layout, text, person identity or branding verbatim. Audience is ordinary Italian-speaking job seekers, especially tradespeople, production, maintenance and logistics workers. Visually direct, trustworthy and immediately Swiss; not luxury-office, fintech, abstract CV stationery or aspirational executive advertising. Premium realistic commercial photography with strong clear shapes, authentic faces, practical workwear, crisp focus, decisive contrast. Natural Swiss-red, navy and real workwear colors. A Swiss national flag can appear clearly in the environment (not a humanitarian Red Cross emblem). No company logos, no invented employer, no salary or job guarantee. No embedded words, lettering, numerals, icons, badges or button; the real advertisement will add very large HTML headline 'LAVORO IN SVIZZERA? LO CERCHIAMO NOI PER TE.' and CTA above/beside this photo. The image itself must feature the intended worker prominently, with a strong recognisable human face even at 100px crop width. Aspect PORTRAIT1:2. An approachable experienced construction/maintenance worker around40, natural masculine appearance, navy practical work jacket, yellow protective helmet and orange safety vest, standing at a tidy outdoor construction site in Ticino. Half-body portrait, face in upper third and fully within the central60% of the canvas, genuine warm confident expression rather than exaggerated sales smile, arms relaxed, no unsafe machinery. Swiss flag and softly focused Swiss mountains behind. Bold clear separation of face and helmet from the background, no decorative negative-space majority. This is photographed for a narrow160x600 banner's top image panel and 300x250 image panel.
